attachments.title: Source clinical note
attachments.text:
ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-07-15
Provider: Dr. Marcus Rodriguez, MD
Department: Emergency Medicine
Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Brought by parents for erratic behavior and recent altercation at school; reportedly brought a knife to school and threatened a teacher.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient is a 15-year-old male with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder who returns for emergency evaluation six months after prior psychiatry assessment for behavioral concerns. His parents report that he has been increasingly irritable and has had several verbal and physical fights with his peers over the past month. They also mention that he has been suspended from school twice for bringing a knife to school and for threatening a teacher.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Conduct disorder (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder

His past medical history is significant for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- No prior surgeries

MEDICATIONS:
He takes methylphenidate.

Home Medications:
- Methylphenidate extended-release 36 mg orally every morning

ALLERGIES:
He has no known drug allergies.

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father with history of conduct disorder and polysubstance use disorder
- Paternal uncle with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
- Mother with major depressive disorder

SOCIAL HISTORY:
His parents own firearms, which they keep in an unlocked cabinet at home.

VITAL SIGNS:
His vital signs are as follows: temperature 37.0°C (98.6°F), blood pressure 130/85 mmHg, pulse 95/min, and respiratory rate 16/min.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On examination, the patient is agitated, has slurred speech, and an unsteady gait.

LABORATORY DATA:
A urine toxicology screen is positive for cannabinoids.

ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Psychiatry
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Mother concerned about patient's behavior at school and home, including multiple suspensions for fighting, stealing from stores, and defiance.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
Over the past year, he has been suspended from school multiple times for getting into fights and has been caught stealing from local stores. His mother reports that he often lies about his whereabouts and has been increasingly defiant at home, breaking curfew and verbally abusing his siblings.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder

The patient has a history of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- No prior surgeries

MEDICATIONS:
He has not been compliant with his medication regimen.

Home Medications:
- Methylphenidate extended-release 36 mg orally every morning

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies

FAMILY HISTORY:
His mother mentions that the family has a history of mood disorders.

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Denied. Alcohol: Denied. Occupation: Student (10th grade).

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On physical examination, the patient has a few bruises on his arms and knuckles. He is uncooperative during the interview and frequently interrupts, providing sarcastic responses. His mother appears distressed.
